title: Flatness of an arbitrary polynomial projection
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $I$ a set. Let $P=B[X_i:i\in I]$ be the polynomial algebra [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], whose elements are finite $B$-linear combinations of monomials. Then the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}P\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ induced by the coefficient inclusion is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].
